public_rationale: The planning premise is supported by contemporary tests. The broader inference remains unsettled. Hallucination experiments show errors but also substantial recognition of those errors, while a narrow transformer learned a causally useful world representation. These findings neither establish reliable general world modeling nor show that essential AGI ingredients had not been invented. Scoring the whole statement as supported would overstate what the planning results demonstrate.
limitations: The conclusion depends on an unspecified account of AGI and its prerequisites.
Narrow world-model successes do not refute a claim of general weakness.
The speculative phrase about what true AGI might require is not treated as a separate firm forecast.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: LLMs are weak at planning and at maintaining world models, which strongly suggests key ingredients of AGI have not yet been invented.

statement.excerpt: To take one example, true AGI might revolve around planning with respect to detailed world models that are maintained over time; as Subbarao Kambhampati has shown, LLMs are weak at planning; as hallucinations show, they are also weak at the maintenance of world models, strongly suggesting some key ingredients have not yet been invented.
statement.document_title: Reports of the birth of AGI are greatly exaggerated

from_speaker: weak at the maintenance of world models
strongly suggesting some key ingredients have not yet been invented
our_interpretation: Weak planning means unreliable production of executable plans that reach their stated goals on manageable problems.
Maintaining world models means keeping representations of relevant facts and states coherent as information changes.
The final clause is an inference from observed failures to missing inventions. It is weaker than certainty, but stronger than merely observing that current systems make mistakes.
The assessment retains that inference rather than silently reducing the claim to its planning component.
The historical premises concern the current generation available in 2023 through October 18; no forecast deadline is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporary evaluations establish planning and state-maintenance weaknesses, and evidence connects those weaknesses to a necessary capability unavailable in existing methods, rather than merely inadequate training, integration or implementation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative contemporary evaluations establish reliable planning and state maintenance, or a demonstrated system using already-existing methods supplies the supposedly missing necessary capabilities. Narrow successes qualify the inference without necessarily refuting it.

evidence.locator: Section 4, Evaluating Planning Capabilities of LLMs in Autonomous Mode
evidence.explanation: GPT-4's poor executable-plan performance supports the planning premise. The paper also reports stronger human performance and benefits from external planners or verification, so its results do not establish that a new invention was necessary.

The study documents erroneous answers followed by further false explanations, but also substantial ability to recognize those mistakes separately. Hallucination therefore does not by itself identify what underlying capability or invention is absent.

A transformer trained on a restricted game learned a causally relevant representation of its world. This qualifies a broad missing-world-model inference, but is not evidence that general-purpose LLMs maintained detailed real-world models reliably.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Evidence identifying a necessary AGI capability, establishing whether existing methods could supply it, and connecting the observed failures to that capability rather than to implementation or training limitations.
